sources.title: South Sudan eVisa service
sources.publisher: South Sudan Ministry of Interior, Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passports and Immigration, Department of e-Visa and Immigration Service
sources.officialityEvidence: The live issuer page is HTTPS-reproducible with certificate verification and identifies the competent South Sudan immigration directorate. It explains approval download and entry presentation, but publishes no ordinary-passport nationality eligibility result.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Are you eligible for a South Sudan Visa?

unresolved.reason: The verified official eVisa issuer describes a pre-travel PDF workflow but publishes no ordinary Singapore-passport eligibility result. A generic account/application flow is not a nationality-terminal eVisa entitlement.
